'''Houlilan''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who provided shelter to several [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Alien Combine]] members after they were attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="XWG" />
